title: Assembly Lines
description: Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

puzzle.goal: A line of k stations processes components one after another; station s takes time t_s. The first component must pass through every station, and after that a new component leaves each time the slowest station, with time τ, finishes one. Write the total time to finish N components.
puzzle.name: Pipeline makespan (fill time plus bottleneck throughput)
puzzle.form: sum ( s , 1 , k , t _ s ) + ( N - 1 ) * τ
puzzle.ask: If every station takes the same time t, the total is (k + N − 1)·t. Find T for k = @{k} stations, N = @{N} components and t = @{t} s.
puzzle.method: Fill the line once (sum of the station times), then one more component per bottleneck cycle for the remaining N − 1.
